messages:
anna_cs: Heads-up team : Cobalt Health asked for a last-minute QBR cost deep-dive. Theyre seeing sudden token inflation after enabling patient-upload summarization. Need: 30/90d burn, top prompt heatmap, and 3 short remediation options (with estimated $ impact). Can @marc_fin take numbers and @riley_prod pull prompt-level breakdown? Also tag any nightly jobs that might be misclassified as gen. Deadline TOMORROW EOD so Sales has something for renewal.

marc_fin: On it. Quick 7d snapshot: gen ~1.6M/day, embeds ~420k/day. Recent jump +28% in gen traffic week-over-week. Rough 90d proj (no mitigation) ~170M tokens. I'll model baseline, moderate-opt (-15%) and aggressive-opt (-30%) scenarios and include dollar deltas.

riley_prod: Running analytics query now. Will return top prompts and flag long-running batch/index jobs. SQL I'll run: ```sql
SELECT prompt_name, SUM(tokens) as tokens, type, COUNT(*) as calls
FROM prod_events
WHERE customer_id='cobalt' AND ts > now() - interval '45 days'
GROUP BY prompt_name, type
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

usage-bot: ALERT: Cobalt Health at 85% of monthly threshold (threshold=1,000,000,000 tokens) as of 2026-03-24T14:12:04Z.

anna_cs: Ugh. Marc  include an immediate "short-term" mitigation we can suggest to Sales (eg temporary throttle + batching pilot + 10% credit if they commit). Riley  mark prompts >1% total and tag embed vs gen.

marc_fin: Draft numbers (public pricing): 90d baseline ~$15.4k. Moderate opt (-15% batching/caching on top prompts) -> ~$13.1k. Aggressive (-30%, mix of batching + dedupe + embed index optimizations) -> ~$10.8k. With 3mo reserved commit (20% discount) baseline net -> ~$12.3k; with optimistic optimizations net down to ~$8.6k. I'll add the sensitivity table to notes.

riley_prod: CSV link when ready: https://internal.redwood/data/cobalt-heat-3532109999.csv. Quick preview: top gen prompts: "upload_summary_v2" 6.4M tokens, "qa_assist_long" 2.3M; top embed job: "patient_index_rebuild" 3.6M (large nightly job). I tagged "upload_summary_v2" as cacheable/dedupe candidate.

priya_sales: For renewal framing: suggest offering a 6-week batching pilot + a one-time 10% invoice credit if they sign a 3-month reserved commit inside the QBR window. Keeps ask friendly and gives them runway. I'll draft the two-sentence ask.

anna_cs: Good. Add an "ops snippet" for SREs to paste into the runbook for immediate mitigation (we'll include in slide 3). Keep it 3 steps.

riley_prod: Ops snippet for slide: ```bash
# 1) enable batching for upload_summary_v2
redwood config set --customer cobalt --feature batching --prompt upload_summary_v2 --value enabled
# 2) route nightly index job to reserved pool to avoid throttles
redwood infra route --customer cobalt --job patient_index_rebuild --pool reserved-temp
# 3) temporary soft throttle if surge persists
redwood rate-limit set --customer cobalt --limit 250r/s
```

usage-bot: SUGGESTION: Recommend alert rule: trigger when 2-day rolling avg > baseline_daily_avg * 1.20. Example: `redwood alerts create --customer cobalt --metric daily_tokens --threshold 1.2 --window 2d --notify cs@redwood`

marc_fin: I'll append a tiny cost-impact table and a suggested conservative ask (3mo reserve at 20% + 15% buffer) so Sales has exact wording.

anna_cs: Timeline: Riley -> final CSV + top-5 heatmap by TOMORROW 10am PT, Marc -> cost table + ask wording by TOMORROW 2pm PT, Priya -> renewal script by TOMORROW 3pm PT. I'll assemble deck and send to Sales for review 4pm PT. Any blockers?

priya_sales: No blockers. I'll draft the friendly ask and the pilot terms; will drop them in the doc by 3pm.

riley_prod: CSV uploaded and heatmap image: https://internal.redwood/graphs/cobalt-heat-3532109999. Flagged nightly index job as a likely mis-attributed embed burst; recommending we discuss moving it to off-peak windows.

anna_cs: Thanks team. Closing thread and will post the assembled slide link when done. :sparkles:
